record.paper_title: Results and Open Problems in Mathematical General Relativity
record.original_question: For the 3+1-dimensional vacuum Einstein equations, can local well-posedness for generic initial data be pushed down from Sobolev regularity H^s_loc × H^{s-1}_loc with s > 2 to the endpoint s = 2, equivalently to the case where the curvature is only in L^2_loc?

evidence.quote: Open problem. Vacuum case, n = 3. Generic solutions with data only in Hloc s × Hloc s−1,s> 2, have been obtained by Klainerman and Rodnianski [22], by using extension to curved manifolds of Fourier analysis and Paley-Littlewood theory. The conjecture is that the result can be extended to s = 2, that is to curvature in L2 loc.

artifact.self_contained_problem: Consider the vacuum Einstein equations Ric(g) = 0 on a 3+1-dimensional Lorentzian manifold, formulated as a Cauchy problem with initial data (Σ, ḡ, k) consisting of a Riemannian 3-manifold (Σ, ḡ) and a symmetric 2-tensor k (the second fundamental form) satisfying the vacuum constraint equations. For initial data with local Sobolev regularity ḡ ∈ H^s_loc(Σ), k ∈ H^{s-1}_loc(Σ), local well-posedness of the Cauchy problem is known for all s > 2. The question is whether local well-posedness for generic such initial data can be extended to the endpoint s = 2, i.e., to the case in which the spacetime Riemann curvature tensor is only assumed to be locally square-integrable (in L^2_loc) on the initial slice (together with a lower bound on the volume radius).
artifact.status_search_result: The bounded L^2 curvature conjecture was proved by S. Klainerman, I. Rodnianski, and J. Szeftel in a series of works culminating in their 2015 Inventiones Mathematicae paper "The Bounded L2 Curvature Conjecture" (Invent. Math. 202 (2015), 91–216). They showed that the time of existence of a classical solution to the vacuum Einstein equations depends only on the L^2 norm of the curvature and a lower bound on the volume radius of the initial data.

status_evidence.title: The Bounded L2 Curvature Conjecture
status_evidence.snippet: This is the main paper in a sequence in which we give a complete proof of the bounded L2 curvature conjecture.
status_evidence.claim: Klainerman, Rodnianski, Szeftel proved the conjecture.

status_evidence.title: The resolution of the bounded L2 curvature conjecture in general relativity
status_evidence.snippet: The resolution of the bounded L2 curvature conjecture in general relativity.
